svg.title: Branchi Desktop and ChatGPT: current boundaries and planned exchange
svg.desc: Desktop has a local record with localhost or optional Obsidian views. ChatGPT uses a separate owner-private Site. The optional implemented bridge imports all eligible cloud-origin records into Desktop. Selected pairing, two-way receipt exchange and execution handoff are planned, not active.

g.text: Architecture guide · implemented paths are solid; future exchange is labelled planned.
AI processing is a separate choice, not local-only.
Explicitly activated conversation and live tools
Available while the desktop is off
No passive access to every chat or local files.
Owner-private hosting is required, not multi-tenant.
Optional current bridge: all eligible cloud-origin records from the connected workspace
Additive import only. No project allowlist, continuous local upload, shared deletion or execution controller.
PLANNED · selected project pairing and acknowledged checkpoint/result receipts
Luna may propose a brief. Running work needs separate consent. This diagram does not activate any sharing or agent.
